correctness.rationale: All seven geometric branches map onto exactly specified unions; slopes are positive beta or beta^2. Conditional uniformity makes the itinerary exactly Markov; the irreducible aperiodic 4-state quotient has pi=(1,1,3-sqrt5,sqrt5-1)/4 and observable (0,1,1,1). Direct multiplication gives first three covariances and a diagonalizable characteristic polynomial with nontrivial eigenvalues beta^-2*exp(±2pi i/3), giving all n and Green–Kubo variance sqrt5/32. Finite-chain Poisson-equation martingale CLT covers stationary and Lebesgue starts. Standalone exact-symbolic verifier executed successfully; it is not substituted for infinite-lag proof.

value.rationale: The right endpoint of the maximal frequency plateau is a canonical Markov parameter singled out by the original paper. It is a motivated gap to quantify digit-count fluctuations rather than just their mean. Exact oscillating three-lag correlations and sigma^2=sqrt5/32 reveal strong anticorrelation and variance suppression relative to independent digits (3/16); the complete sequence is an interpretable invariant for fluctuation estimates and comparison with nearby plateau parameters. This is more than a routine isolated count.
